name: dynamic-item-info
author: DaggerHashimoto
description: Turns the item information window into clear sections: live stats, refine values now and at the next level, a labelled comparison with what you have equipped, the copies you carry and their restrictions, effects, random options, cards you can expand, and whether your level meets the requirements. Works on any item the game shows you, and keeps the game's own art, buttons and full description. Renewal and pre-renewal.
